read.thesis: Capex guided above $20B for 2026 (six factories, AI compute) with no prior guidance to compare, while auto margins ex-credits rose to 17.9% on 16% lower deliveries and energy margin compression is flagged.

utilisation.quote: Our biggest constraint globally continues to be on the battery pack front.

capex.quote: At the moment, we are expecting that CapEx would be in excess of $20 billion.

triggers.label: 2026 capex above $20B
triggers.quote: At the moment, we are expecting that CapEx would be in excess of $20 billion.

triggers.label: Model S and X production ending
triggers.quote: we expect to wind down S and X production next quarter and basically stop production of Model S and X next quarter.

triggers.label: Energy margin compression flagged
triggers.quote: we expect margin compression from the increased low-cost competition impacts to market from policy uncertainty, and the cost of tariffs.

triggers.label: Auto margin ex-credits 15.4% → 17.9%
triggers.quote: automotive margins, excluding credits, improved sequentially from 15.4% to 17.9%.

guidance.quote: At the moment, we are expecting that CapEx would be in excess of $20 billion.

guidance.value: dozens of major cities by end of year
guidance.quote: we expect to be in dozens of major cities by the end of the year.
We expect to start production in April.

red_flags.label: Energy margin compression flagged
red_flags.quote: we expect margin compression from the increased low-cost competition impacts to market from policy uncertainty, and the cost of tariffs.

red_flags.label: Services margin down 10.5% to 8.8%
red_flags.quote: Services and others margin declined from 10.5% to 8.8%

red_flags.label: Opex up $500M on stock comp and Maestro charges
red_flags.quote: operating expenses increased sequentially $500 million in Q4
